item.description:
What's new in ShawNotch 1.7.24

  • Using another display? Choose where the notch lives in Settings → General → Show the notch on: your MacBook's notch, the main display, or whichever screen you're using.
  • Click the closed notch to open it straight away, and click anywhere else to close it. Clicking at the open notch's left or right edge slides out the Mirror or the Calendar.
  • Ready for MacBooks with a pill-shaped camera: the notch floats around it like the iPhone's Dynamic Island.
